{{Otheruses|Darkness}}
The '''''Darkness''''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Nebulon-B frigate]] that launched an attack on the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[Ram's Head]]'' and ''[[Libra]]'' while the [[Shield X Deflector Shield]] was being delivered. The attack was thwarted by [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] in an [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] and a few other [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] who turned to this [[Starship/Legends|starship]] destroying it.
